title: Unify presubmit prober with dependency provenance collector and add lightweight CI health shim
author: Lena Hofmann
release_notes: Add presubmit prober and dependency provenance collector. Introduce lightweight CI health shim to reduce noisy failures during presubmit. No breaking changes.
description: Context: We've had intermittent presubmit flakes caused by long-running health checks and noisy dependency rotations that surface late in the pipeline. Motivation: improve premerge signal quality and capture dependency provenance to make dep-rotation decisions auditable and testable. What I changed: 1) Introduced a presubmit prober (tools/presubmit-prober) that runs a prioritized, lightweight set of health probes (gateway sanity, small inference smoke, KV cache warmpath) aimed to run under 30s; 2) Added a dependency provenance collector (tools/dep-provenance) that records resolved transitive dep versions and a short provenance blob (vcs refs, checksum, package manager snapshot) for each CI run; 3) Added a small CI health shim image (docker/ci-shim/Dockerfile) used for memory/concurrency isolation in the fastpath lane; 4) Refactored .github/workflows/premerge.yml to wire the prober into the staged fastpath lane with a soft-failure path (marks warnings but does not block on first rollout) and to attach provenance artifacts to the workflow run; 5) Small lint/test pipeline cleanups and removal of a duplicate step that caused duplicate reporting. Rollout plan: staged rollout on the fastpath lane for 1 week, send provenance data to internal bucket for 30 days, enable soft-failure alerts (SLO: <=1% false positive over 1 week) before flipping to hard gate. Testing: unit tests for the collector, integration smoke against a lightweight hosted runtime in the benchmark-lab, manual dogfooding on redwood-example repos. Backwards compatibility: presubmit prober defaults to opt-in via label "ci-fastpath-prober" and collector is enabled for CI runs created after merge. Notes: this PR keeps changes shallow in the monorepo (tools/, .github/, docker/) and deliberately avoids runtime code edits to minimize risk.

reviews: Marcus Li: Nice separation of concerns here. Can we ensure the prober respects existing rate limits on the hosted API? Requested change: add client-side throttling and a default timeout of 10s per probe.
Lena Hofmann: Added client-side token bucket and a 10s timeout. Also added configuration via PRESUBMIT_PROBER_TIMEOUT env var. PTAL.
Priya Rao: The provenance blob is useful. Request: include the lockfile hash and a condensed dep tree for easier diffs. Also, please make retention configurable via CI variable.
Lena Hofmann: Included lockfile hash and added condensed dep-tree serializer and CI variable PROVENANCE_RETENTION_DAYS (default 30). Updated tests.
Samir Patel: Verified fastpath integration in a dogfood run. CI run uploaded artifacts successfully. Approving pending small nits on docs.
Priya Rao: Approving after doc nits fixed.
notes: This PR was intentionally kept narrow to reduce blast radius: no changes to serving runtime, only CI and tooling. The provenance collector writes to ephemeral artifact storage; a follow-up will add long-term retention and ingestion into the dep-rotation dashboard.
human_readable_summary: Adds a fast presubmit prober and a dependency provenance collector to improve premerge signal fidelity and to capture dep metadata for safer rotations. Staged rollout on fastpath lane; soft-failure by default. CI green; merged to main via squash.
